parameters.query:
with conta_resolvida as (
  select a.id::text as account_id, a.bank, a.name as account_name
  from public.accounts a
  where (a.owner_id = $9::uuid or a.user_id = $11::uuid)
    and nullif($12, '') is not null
    and (
      $12 ilike '%' || a.bank || '%'
      or $12 ilike '%' || a.name || '%'
      or (a.type = 'credito' and $12 ilike '%cart%')
      or (a.type in ('conta_corrente','debito') and (
        $12 ilike '%deb%' or $12 ilike '%déb%' or $12 ilike '%pix%' or $12 ilike '%conta%'
      ))
    )
  order by
    case when ($12 ilike '%' || a.bank || '%' or $12 ilike '%' || a.name || '%') then 0 else 1 end,
    case
      when a.type = 'credito' and $12 ilike '%cart%' then 0
      when a.type in ('conta_corrente','debito') and (
        $12 ilike '%deb%' or $12 ilike '%déb%' or $12 ilike '%pix%' or $12 ilike '%conta%'
      ) then 0
      else 1
    end
  limit 1
),
novo_lancamento as (
  insert into public.transactions
    (description, date, category_id, subcategory_id, type, value, account_id, owner_id, payment_date, pending_review, created_at, user_id)
  values
    (
      $1,
      $2::date,
      $3,
      nullif($4, ''),
      $5,
      $6::numeric,
      coalesce(nullif($7, ''), (select account_id from conta_resolvida), 'dinheiro'),
      $9::uuid,
      nullif($8, '')::date,
      false,
      nullif($10, '')::timestamptz,
      $11::uuid
    )
  returning id, description, date, category_id, value, type, owner_id, account_id
),
conta as (
  select op.user_id
  from public.owner_profiles op
  where op.id = (select owner_id from novo_lancamento)
),
periodo as (
  select
    date_trunc('month', (select date from novo_lancamento))::date as mes_inicio,
    (date_trunc('month', (select date from novo_lancamento)) + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date as mes_fim
),
-- "Ambos" nao e mais proprietario: e uma marcacao por categoria/ano feita no app.
-- Se a categoria estiver marcada como conjunta, o orcamento e o realizado passam a
-- considerar todos os proprietarios da conta, nao so o do lancamento.
eh_conjunta as (
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.budget_joint_categories bjc
    where bjc.user_id = (select user_id from conta)
      and bjc.category_id = (select category_id from novo_lancamento)
      and bjc.year between extract(year from (select mes_inicio from periodo))::int
                       and extract(year from (select mes_fim from periodo))::int
  ) as conjunta
),
owners_escopo as (
  select op.id, op.name, op.is_joint
  from public.owner_profiles op
  where op.user_id = (select user_id from conta)
    and (
      (select conjunta from eh_conjunta)
      or op.id = (select owner_id from novo_lancamento)
    )
),
planejado_por_owner as (
  select oe.id, oe.name, oe.is_joint,
         coalesce(sum(b.planned_value), 0) as planejado
  from owners_escopo oe
  left join public.budgets b
    on b.owner_id = oe.id
   and b.category_id = (select category_id from novo_lancamento)
   and b.year = extract(year from (select mes_inicio from periodo))::int
   and b.month = extract(month from (select mes_inicio from periodo))::int - 1
  group by oe.id, oe.name, oe.is_joint
),
planejado as (
  select coalesce(sum(planejado), 0) as planejado from planejado_por_owner
),
realizado as (
  -- Postgres: um CTE nao enxerga as linhas inseridas por outro CTE no mesmo statement
  -- (todos usam o mesmo snapshot). Por isso somamos os OUTROS lancamentos e adicionamos
  -- o valor recem-lancado separadamente.
  select coalesce(sum(abs(t.value)), 0) + abs((select value from novo_lancamento)) as realizado
  from public.transactions t, periodo p
  where t.owner_id in (select id from owners_escopo)
    and t.category_id = (select category_id from novo_lancamento)
    and t.type = (select type from novo_lancamento)
    and t.deleted = false
    and t.id <> (select id from novo_lancamento)
    and t.date >= p.mes_inicio and t.date <= p.mes_fim
),
conta_final as (
  select a.bank, a.name as account_name
  from public.accounts a
  where a.id::text = (select account_id from novo_lancamento)
)
select
  (select id from novo_lancamento) as lancamento_id,
  (select description from novo_lancamento) as description,
  (select date from novo_lancamento) as date,
  (select category_id from novo_lancamento) as category_id,
  (select value from novo_lancamento) as value,
  (select type from novo_lancamento) as type,
  (select account_id from novo_lancamento) as account_id,
  (select bank from conta_final) as bank,
  (select account_name from conta_final) as account_name,
  (select planejado from planejado) as planejado,
  (select realizado from realizado) as realizado,
  (select conjunta from eh_conjunta) as categoria_conjunta,
  (select json_agg(json_build_object('nome', name, 'planejado', planejado) order by is_joint, name)
     from planejado_por_owner
    where planejado > 0 or is_joint = false) as planejado_por_titular,
  (select mes_inicio from periodo) as mes_inicio,
  (select mes_fim from periodo) as mes_fim;
